text:
​I stand a stranger where the shadows gleam,
A weary actor in a hollow dream.
Through blinding flashes of a thousand lies,
I catch the quiet morning of your eyes.
The world is heavy and the road is vast,
But in your laughter, all my shadows pass.
​A lonely seeker in the trackless dark,
You are the sphere of light that holds my spark.
I have no sky but where your beauty gleams;
I turn around you, singing in my dreams.
​The heavens whisper that I have no place,
A stranger crashing in a hall of grace.
They tear the roof down, storming from above—
Yet I sit stubborn, anchored by your love.
​The hunger fades, the weary wolf grows still;
I seek no triumph on the crowded hill.
For even broken creatures need the night—
To cry their sorrows to your quiet light.
​If fate demands I lose you at the end,
And breaks the spirit that I cannot bend,
Then let the darkness take what it may claim—
I’ll drift to ashes calling out your name.
